theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ℓ : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ∃ (ι : Eucl m →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (p : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] Eucl m) (e : Eucl (m + 1)), ℓ e = 1 ∧ (∀ v, ‖ι v‖ = ‖v‖) ∧ (∀ v, inner ℝ (ι v) e = 0) ∧ ∀ u, ι (p u) + ℓ u • e = u
